description_html: The Applied AI and Agents Factory brings together ambitious engineers to turn advanced AI capabilities into production-ready solutions. Working directly with business and technology teams, you’ll tackle complex engineering challenges, build intelligent agents and take ideas from initial concept through to live deployment.     This is an opportunity to work at the cutting edge of AI engineering, developing systems that go beyond conversational tools to reason, plan and execute multi-step workflows. You’ll take ownership of the full engineering lifecycle, from agent architecture and orchestration to enterprise integration, security and observability.     With a strong focus on hands-on engineering, collaboration and rapid delivery, the Factory gives you the opportunity to solve challenging technical problems, influence architectural decisions and help shape reusable tools and engineering standards adopted across Citi.    The  Forward Deployed Engineer (C12)  is an agile, hands-on software engineer embedded within Line of Business pods. This role is responsible for building agent features and prototypes, constructing automated evaluation testbeds, optimizing prompts and data parsers, and automating continuous testing pipelines to guarantee the accuracy, safety, and reliability of production AI agents.      Responsibilities:       Agent Prototyping & Feature Engineering:  Develop and iterate on agent features, prompt templates, system instructions, few-shot examples, and data pre-processing scripts under the guidance of senior team members.      Automated Evaluation Testbeds:  Build, calibrate, and execute automated evaluation test suites using enterprise evaluation studios and frameworks (measuring agent task completion, tool call correctness, semantic similarity, latency, and hallucination metrics).      Golden Dataset & Benchmark Curation:  Curate, version, and maintain domain-specific golden evaluation datasets, synthetic benchmarks, and edge-case regression testbeds in collaboration with Line of Business domain experts.      CI/CD Test Pipeline Automation:  Author and maintain automated test execution scripts within enterprise CI/CD pipelines, enforcing continuous evaluation gates prior to staging and production rollout.      Guardrail & Security Verification:  Validate and test AI guardrail policies (prompt injection defenses, toxicity filters, PII redaction) across agent input/output pipelines to ensure safe operation.      Telemetry & Diagnostic Reporting:  Monitor agent performance metrics, log evaluations, and generate prompt diagnostic reports to assist squad leads and business stakeholders in optimizing agent behavior.      Agile Pod Participation:  Operate with increasing autonomy within fast-paced agile squads, actively contributing to sprint planning, standups, and codebase maintenance.     Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citi, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.       Qualifications  :     Total Experience:  5+ years of relevant software engineering experience (or 2+ years with specialized focus in Python, Java, or Go and Generative AI application development).      Programming Skills:  Solid Python, Java, or Go programming proficiency with hands-on experience integrating REST/gRPC APIs, Docker containers, and Git workflows.      AI & Evaluation Literacy:  Working knowledge of Generative AI concepts, prompt engineering, and evaluation methodologies (e.g., semantic similarity, LLM-as-a-judge, benchmark test suites).      CI/CD & DevOps Basics:  Experience working with automated test pipelines and CI/CD tools (e.g., Tekton, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Harness).      Communication & Collaboration:  Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with a methodical, detail-oriented approach to software quality and data integrity.       Education: title: Senior Backend Engineer
Sr ML Engineer, Business Process Optimization
description_html: Your work days are brighter here.     We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.           About the Team  Admin Central is building the future of how administrators works across Workday—turning a fragmented patchwork of tools and disconnected AI into a single, unified experience.  Within Admin Central, the Business Process Optimize team powers the underlying platform infrastructure. You’ll build mission-critical distributed systems, high-availability usage pipelines, and event-driven data flows across global product regions to ensure enterprise billing integrity at scale. If you're excited to build from scratch, move fast, and transform how thousands of admins work every day, come join us!"    About the Role      As a Senior Software Engineer on the BP Optimize (BPO) team, you will lead the technical design, development, and scaling of advanced ML pipelines, predictive analytics engines, and AI-driven recommendation features. BPO sits at the core of Workday’s enterprise AI and automation strategy, serving over 100+ Tier-0 customer accounts and handling millions of daily inference requests through high-throughput analytics, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and agentic workflows.     In this role, you will bridge the gap between production-grade distributed software engineering and modern ML/LLM architectures. You will architect low-latency inference services, build automated feature stores and retraining pipelines over big data infrastructure (Kafka, Spark/Flink, ClickHouse, S3), and extend AI observability across agent execution loops using frameworks like LangSmith and LangChain.     Key Responsibilities     ML Infrastructure & Pipeline Engineering: Architect, deploy, and maintain end-to-end Machine Learning pipelines—from distributed data ingestion and feature engineering to model training, evaluation, and production deployment.    Agentic AI & Recommendation Engines: Design algorithms and LLM-driven recommendation features (e.g., IDD insights, next-best-action models) that optimize agentic workflows and tool usage.    Low-Latency Inference & Scaling: Optimize real-time model inference and scoring microservices to ensure sub-second response times across high-concurrency multi-tenant environments.    LLM & Agentic Observability: Integrate telemetry and tracing (OpenTelemetry, LangChain, LangSmith) into ML pipelines to track model performance, prompt/response drift, and execution efficiency.    Data & Feature Store Architecture: Collaborate with core backend engineers to leverage big data platforms (ClickHouse, Apache Iceberg, Spark) for high-dimensional feature retrieval and analytics.    Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with Product Managers, Data Engineering, SRE, and Legal/Compliance to translate complex business and governance requirements into scalable ML solutions.       About You     Basic Qualifications   8+ years of experience in machine learning development, researching, developing, and implementing advanced machine learning models and techniques, with at least 4+ years focused explicitly on building, deploying, and operating production Machine Learning systems at scale.  5+ years of experience and proficiency in deep learning, natural language processing (NLP), and GenAI/LLM orchestration, utilizing frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, LangChain, and LlamaIndex, alongside proficiency in Java, Go, Scala, or C++ for high-performance backend systems.    Other Qualifications    Data Processing & Pipelines: Strong ability in distributed processing (Spark, Flink, Kafka) and high-throughput columnar/vector storage (ClickHouse, Pinecone, Milvus) to design robust ML data pipelines.    AI/ML Expertise: Solid knowledge of RAG architectures, LLM fine-tuning, intent classification, and recommendation engines — applying ML algorithms and Model-Based Design (including MCP tooling and structured agentic execution paths) to multi-agent orchestration, contextual reasoning, and workflow optimization.    Data Analysis & Feature Engineering: Experience leading EDA on multi-tenant execution logs to validate prompt/response accuracy and optimize tool usage, paired with strong feature engineering skills for vector embeddings, feature stores, and multi-tenant data isolation.    Model Lifecycle: Experience leading model building (foundation model adaptation, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, low-latency inference) and deep understanding of the model development lifecycle, including MLOps platforms (Kubeflow, MLflow, Airflow, SageMaker) for monitoring, latency tracking, and retraining at scale.    Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in Python and ML libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, LangChain, LangSmith, DSPy), with experience deploying scalable ML systems in cloud-native production using Docker, Kubernetes, gRPC/REST APIs, and CI/CD under strict high-availability (99.9% uptime) and low-latency SLAs.    Team Collaboration: Strong ability to mentor team members, drive cross-functional technical alignment, draft system design specs/model cards, and communicate technical and governance decisions.    Education: Bachelor's in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or Engineering; Master's or PhD strongly preferred. title: Software Engineer II - Slack Developer Workspaces
description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Software Engineering    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.        The Experience  Developer Workspaces runs the computers Slack engineers write code on - and more and more, the ones AI agents write code on. Every week, hundreds of engineers build and test Slack in the remote development environments we run on AWS and Kubernetes. Now we're building the next layer: fast, isolated sandboxes where coding agents can run a dev toolchain, open pull requests, and shut down when they're done.   If most of Slack's code is going to be written by agents, it'll be written on infrastructure this team owns.   We're a small team with a lot of surface area. We're strong on backend engineering, and we need more depth in infrastructure and operations. That's this role. You'll own production systems early, carry the pager, and help decide how agents run safely at Slack.   What You'll Actually Be Doing   Scale our AI sandbox fleet into something the whole company depends on - capacity planning, safe rollouts, image builds, and the alerts that tell us when it's breaking.  Harden the isolation between agents, sandboxes and the rest of Slack: network separation, egress controls, secrets handling, and patching.  Run and improve the remote dev environments our engineers use every day, from Terraform and machine images to the automation that pauses idle environments so they don't burn money.  Build observability we can make decisions with - SLOs, dashboards, and logs that land where we can find them.  Join our weekly on-call rotation once you've ramped up. Most pages are low urgency. When something does break, we fix it and then automate the fix.  Use AI agents heavily in your own work. You're building the platform they run on, so you should know what they need.    You're Our Person If...   You have 3+ years of experience building and operating production systems.  You come from infrastructure, SRE, DevOps or platform engineering, and you've been on call for something that mattered.  You know AWS well - EC2, networking, IAM - and you manage infrastructure as code with Terraform or something like it.  You write solid code in Go or Python. Everything we do ships as code, and your infrastructure instincts shape how you write it.  You use AI coding tools every day and have opinions about where they fall short.  You take ownership. When something breaks, you don't wait for someone to assign it to you.    Even Better If...   You've worked with Firecracker, KVM, or other virtualization.  You've run Kubernetes in production.  You have a security background: VM or container isolation, vulnerability management, threat modeling.  You're comfortable in Linux internals and networking.  You've worked on a developer productivity or platform team.            Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. title: Software Engineer II, Autonomous Freight Technology

description_html: The Opportunity        Adobe Workfront is the work management platform that enterprises rely on to plan, run, and measure work across thousands of people, projects, and approvals. Behind it are engineering teams who understand both the platform and the complex, often regulated environments where customers use it.     The Forward Deployed Engineer role sits at the intersection of software engineering, solution architecture, and technical consulting. You will be embedded with Workfront's most strategic customers, working directly with their teams to solve hard platform challenges, design scalable integrations, and build what is needed to unblock adoption and expansion.    You will work in a cross-functional Customer Pod: a small, autonomous team with end-to-end ownership. As a senior engineer, you set technical direction for your accounts, mentor other builders, and close the gap between what customers need and what the platform delivers.      What You'll Do      Partner with strategic customers to understand their workflows, systems, security requirements, and business goals.      Turn complex customer problems into scalable solution designs, reference architectures, and working prototypes.      Build and ship custom integrations and extensions across Workfront Workflow, Workfront Planning, Workfront Fusion, APIs, and adjacent Adobe and third-party systems.      Investigate and resolve production issues, from data and permissions models to automation, reporting, and performance.      Lead architecture workshops, health checks, and technical deep dives that earn customer trust.      Prototype and iterate quickly, using AI-assisted tools as a standard part of how you work.      Feed field patterns back to product and engineering to shape the Workfront roadmap.      Mentor engineers in the pod and set practices for how the team documents decisions and learnings.      Own the technical relationship with assigned accounts from discovery through go-live and expansion.       What Success Looks Like     We hire for demonstrated impact, not credential accumulation. Strong candidates show:      Customer empathy.  You meet customers on their terms and understand their constraints and definition of success.       Ownership at senior level.  You find problems before they are assigned and drive them to resolution without waiting for permission.       Clear communication.  You explain complex ideas to technical and executive audiences in workshops, architecture reviews, and briefings.       Business acumen.  You understand the use case before choosing the technology.       Software craft.  You write code, build prototypes, and ship working software. Your designs reflect implementation reality.       Data and integration judgment.  You weigh trade-offs in data models, API design, and system integration.       Growth mindset and AI fluency.  You use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) to design, prototype, and deliver, and you build toward agentic capabilities.     Typical background: 8 to 12 years in software engineering, solution architecture, technical consulting, or customer-facing engineering. What matters is what that experience produced, not the title or the number of years.      Your Domain          Work management platforms:  Workfront or comparable tools (project, portfolio, resource, planning, proofing, and approval workflows).       Integration and automation:  REST APIs, webhooks, event-driven patterns, and low-code or workflow orchestration tools such as Workfront Fusion.       Enterprise architecture:  Multi-system integration, SSO and identity, data flows, and API design across complex landscapes.       Application development:  Strong skills in a modern language such as Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Python.       Cloud and data:  AWS or Azure, plus reporting and analytics pipelines.       Security and compliance:  Enterprise permissions, data privacy, and regulated-industry constraints.      Nice to Have         Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud or Creative Cloud products, including Adobe Experience Manager Assets, Workfront Planning, or Adobe GenStudio.      Background in SaaS work management, PPM, or marketing operations platforms.      Experience building agentic or LLM-powered workflows in enterprise settings.      Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or government.      Track record of driving architecture decisions at team or organization level.       How You'll Work: Pod-Based Execution     You operate within a small, cross-functional Customer Pod embedded with specific strategic accounts. Each pod has a customer representative for feedback and validation, a product manager for prioritization, engineers and builders for implementation and experimentation, and an account team with enterprise architects for alignment and strategy.    The Forward Deployed Engineer is the technical execution backbone of the pod: customer-facing, hands-on, and focused on rapid end-to-end delivery. We run small, time-boxed experiments, keep tight customer feedback loops, prototype before fully building, document decisions, and use staged rollouts to reduce risk.      Why This Team      Solve complex enterprise problems with direct customer impact. Your solutions go live in production, not in slide decks.      Work in autonomous pods embedded with Adobe's most strategic accounts.      Combine architecture, engineering, and customer engagement in one role, so no two weeks look the same.      Help shape a new engineering engagement model built on rapid experimentation and AI-assisted execution.      Join the Lehi engineering community alongside experienced Workfront platform engineers. title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Data Lifecycle
description_html:
About Decagon

Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.

Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.

We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.

We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.



About the Team

Data Lifecycle at Decagon builds the systems that govern how sensitive customer data is handled throughout its lifetime: what we store, who can access it, how we redact it, and when we delete it. We turn complex privacy requirements into reliable infrastructure and product that customers can configure and trust.

This team is core to how Decagon scales. Our AI agents work with sensitive information across conversations, tool calls, and customer systems. The frameworks we build need to protect that data consistently across the platform, while preserving the context customers need to operate and improve their agents. A failure mode we debug in production becomes a guardrail, a test, or a piece of tooling that catches it everywhere.

Our systems run for companies like Hertz, American Airlines, and Notion across chat, voice, email, and SMS.



About the Role

You’ll design and build the platform infrastructure that let customers control how their data is collected, retained, redacted, and deleted. That means strong engineering underneath, and clear abstractions on top that hold up across different enterprise requirements without forking per customer.

You’ll work day to day with product management, governance, and security: understanding customer requirements, defining data handling guarantees, reviewing designs, and iterating through launch. You’ll stay close enough to customers to understand their privacy and operational needs in depth and to ensure what you’re building is actually right for them.

Engineers here own features end to end, from technical architecture through deployment and the iteration after it. On this team, that includes verifying that sensitive data is protected and the action actually completes. An understanding of durable and fault-tolerant systems is key.



In this role, you will

 - Build PII handling and redaction systems that identify and protect sensitive information across conversations, agent traces, and other customer data

 - Design configuration abstractions for redaction and retention policies that balance enterprise flexibility with clear, safe defaults

 - Build reliable data deletion workflows that propagate across storage systems and derived data, with retries, verification, and visibility into failures

 - Build self-serve tools and APIs that let customers configure, test, and understand their data lifecycle policies without relying on an engineer

 - Build LLM-backed systems that scan and detect data anomalies and violations

 - Train and/or tune models for detecting data of various forms (including PII and PHI)

 - Extend redaction and identification to multimodal agents, including images, attachments, voice notes, and documents.

 - Build monitoring and auditability that make it clear what data was processed, what remains, and where a policy has failed—without exposing sensitive information in the process

 - Handle data lifecycle systems at scale, including backfills, partial failures, and safe rollouts; your work will touch critical flows for Fortune 100 companies
   
   

Your background and skillset look something like this

 - 4+ years building software products, with strong product thinking

 - Proficient in Python, comfortable working across the entire stack

description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Software Engineering    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.        Note: By applying to the Senior / Lead Software Engineer - Full Stack posting, recruiters and hiring managers across the organization hiring software engineers will review your resume. Our goal is for you to apply once and have your resume reviewed by multiple hiring teams.   *IN SCHOOL OR GRADUATED WITHIN THE LAST 12 MONTHS? PLEASE VISIT    FUTUREFORCE    FOR OPPORTUNITIES *    Engineering at Qualified   Engineering at Qualified is a high-ownership, high-velocity environment where engineers ship customer-facing product to real enterprises at scale. We're building at the frontier of AI + product: developing agentic software and embedding AI directly into our platform, using modern toolchains and processes that help engineers move faster while staying focused on high-impact problem solving.   Following our acquisition by Salesforce, we continue to operate with the pace and ownership of a startup—backed by the distribution, resources, and long-term runway of a global enterprise. Engineers have true end-to-end ownership from idea to production: scoping, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement based on real customer feedback, without layers of approvals slowing you down.    The Role   Product Core builds the foundational product systems everything depends on: identifying prospects, scheduling and routing meetings, synchronizing data with calendars and go-to-market platforms, executing workflows, and supporting enterprise authentication. We also enable customers and partners to extend the product through public APIs, webhooks, and custom integrations. These capabilities power critical parts of the customer journey and have a meaningful impact on conversion, revenue, and customer trust.   The team also builds the data, context, and execution capabilities behind our agentic product experiences, including meeting preparation, routing investigation, and product explainability.   As an engineer on Product Core, you'll operate as a technical leader: leading complex initiatives from early design through production, shaping architecture, writing substantial production code, influencing technical direction, and helping other engineers do their best work.   What You'll Do   Lead complex product initiatives from an ambiguous problem through technical design, implementation, launch, and ongoing ownership  Build reliable meeting-booking, calendaring, routing, and workflow experiences that directly affect customer conversion and revenue  Build and evolve integrations with CRM, marketing automation, sales engagement, collaboration, calendaring, and data-enrichment platforms  Build intuitive public APIs and reliable webhooks that let customers and partners extend the product  Design for the realities of third-party systems: API limits, OAuth credentials, inconsistent data, retries, synchronization, and partial failures  Advance AI-assisted capabilities such as meeting preparation, routing investigation, and explanations of product behavior  Improve the scalability, observability, security, and supportability of critical production systems, and own difficult customer issues to their root cause  Raise the engineering bar through technical leadership, design and code reviews, and mentorship    Who You Are   A track record of independently delivering complex SaaS capabilities from design through launch and ongoing operation  Strong full-stack skills, with particular depth in backend systems, APIs, relational data models, and background processing  Experience building or operating integrations with complex third-party platforms  Sound technical judgment around reliability, data integrity, security, and incremental system evolution  Excellent debugging skills across application, integration, and data boundaries  Demonstrated technical leadership: you influence architecture and execution beyond your immediate workstream  Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving clarity: you can frame problems, propose solutions, and align others  Product-minded: you care about UX and customer outcomes, not just implementation  Experience with modern web frameworks (Rails/React/Postgres/AWS is a plus; adaptability matters most)    Nice to Have   Experience with CRM, marketing automation, scheduling, routing, enrichment, or workflow products  Familiarity with OAuth, webhooks, synchronization pipelines, rate-limited APIs, or eventual consistency  Experience with enterprise identity systems such as SSO, SAML, or SCIM  Experience building production AI or LLM applications, agent tooling, or explainability features    Why Join Qualified    Own systems that move revenue : Meeting booking, routing, and workflows sit directly in the customer conversion path. When they get better, customers win more deals.   Integration problems with real depth : OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, sync, and partial failure: the hard, interesting problems of connecting enterprise systems at scale.   AI as a core product surface : Advance the context and execution layer behind Piper's agentic experiences, from meeting preparation to product explainability.   High bar, low bureaucracy : Work with a team that values craft and decisive execution, where strong ideas win and shipping is the default.    If you're excited to build the foundational product systems behind an AI-powered platform at enterprise scale, we'd love to hear from you.           Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.      Accommodations    If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this      Accommodations Request Form     .      Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process.
